editorial.blurb: A charming Parisian-style café serving elegant French classics in a beautifully designed space that whisks you away to Paris.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early for brunch to enjoy fresh pastries and baked goods from the case; the beef bourguignon and quiche are standout lunch picks.

topDishes.note: Tender, flavorful, served with mushrooms, carrots, and rice
